title: Fixed Three-Level Leaf Mobile and Cantilever Stand
description: One newly authored whole fixed leaf-suspension sculpture on its own complete grounded elliptical foot and rounded cantilever stand. Five warm-alloy-look complete rods form three explicit suspension levels and carry six new finite-thickness organic leaf plates in muted sage and ochre. Every suspension wire seats into both its whole parent and child, and the complete stand seats into the finite foot. Intentional fixed intersections, not articulation. Original numerical silhouettes, branching layout, palette and stand; no artist design, branded object, historical replica, reused balance pans or old pendulum mechanism. One model zero scenes, four opaque PBR roles, metre scale and native Z up. Static display appearance only: no dynamic balance, swinging, kinetic behaviour, wind response, structural strength, manufacture, installation, stability or safety capability; no rig, animation or interaction.
